localContext: Knoxville is the headquarters city of the Tennessee Valley Authority and sits about twenty-five miles from the Oak Ridge national laboratory and weapons-complex sites. Around it are TVA fossil and nuclear generation, aluminum and automotive-component manufacturing in Blount County, Air National Guard aviation at McGhee Tyson, and a nuclear and defence supply chain. The work runs to ASME Section XI and III, AWS, and owner quality programmes, so technicians need documented qualification and clean records from the start.
certPathwayNote: Knoxville-area employers certify technicians under their own written practices built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Nuclear and defence customers add quality-assurance flow-down, including performance demonstrations for some UT work, which the employer's Level III reconciles. ASNT central certification remains an option for individuals without a sponsor, and Atlantis NDT prepares candidates for it.
